title: Accelerating Model Training on Ascend Chips: An Industrial System for Profiling, Analysis and Optimization
problem: Model training on Ascend accelerators suffers from performance inefficiencies that require systematic identification through profiling. Industrial-scale deployments need comprehensive analysis tools to optimize hardware utilization for training workloads.
motivation: Ascend chips are critical accelerators for AI training in production environments; systematic profiling and optimization directly improve training throughput and reduce computational costs.
method: The system integrates performance profiling to monitor Ascend behavior during training, analytical techniques to identify bottlenecks, and optimization methods to accelerate kernels. It combines hardware-level performance counters with software-level optimization strategies targeting training efficiency.
key_novelty: An integrated industrial-grade profiling and optimization framework specifically designed for model training acceleration on Ascend chips.
contributions: Comprehensive profiling system for Ascend training workloads
Analysis methodology for identifying training bottlenecks
Optimization techniques for model training acceleration
Industrial deployment results and optimization insights
limitations: Limitations not discussed in available title information.
primary_theme: Industrial profiling and optimization for model training on Ascend accelerators
